# zer0

> zer0 is Kevin Rajan's studio for autonomous systems: agent infrastructure, reproducible evaluations, digital twins of the real world, and tools that protect flow. Built in public, with evidence.

Canonical site: https://kvnloo.github.io/blueprint/
Founder: Kevin Rajan (GitHub kvnloo, X @_kvnloo)
Thesis: Engineering for human flourishing.

## Pages

- [Home](https://kvnloo.github.io/blueprint/#/): thesis, pillars, featured work, proof.
- [Work](https://kvnloo.github.io/blueprint/#/work): every public project with area and status.
- [Research](https://kvnloo.github.io/blueprint/#/research): z0evals, writing, research we build on.
- [About](https://kvnloo.github.io/blueprint/#/about): principles, claim labels, timeline.
- [Open source](https://kvnloo.github.io/blueprint/#/oss): upstream projects, credited to their maintainers.

## How to read claims

- Status labels (live, active, prototype, early, archived) describe maturity, not activity.
- Claim labels: verified (checked against a receipt), reported, provisional, deprecated.
- A fork, draft or review is not an upstream merge. Only merged work counts as a contribution.
- 2025 essays under Writing are vision pieces; their numbers are not measured results.

## Sources of truth

- [Build log (boplog)](https://kvnloo.github.io/boplog/llms.txt): authoritative project archive and counts.
- [z0evals](https://kvnloo.github.io/z0evals/): frozen evaluation reports.
- [Contribution archive](https://kvnloo.github.io/gh-contrib-archive/): public issues, PRs and commits.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/kvnloo)
